title: This trip was truly for the plays (and kicklines) #broadway #theatre ...
transcript: come with me on a quick 4 day trip in New York City started day one off getting some work done at the Drama Bookshop before going to Playwrights Horizons for their production of Down State day 2 got some breakfast before heading to the Belasco to see my second production of ain't No Mo this year and grab dinner at 5 Napkin Burger before heading to Will arbery's brand new play Evanston Salt cost climbing and finishing the night off with a lovely walk in Bryant Park day 3 started off early to get some rush tickets and some coffee at the drama bookshop of course before seeing my favorite adaptation of A Christmas Carol grabbing monday's tickets at TKTS and then going to Atlantic Theatre Company for their production of Lloyd Suh’s New Play The Far Country then finished the trip off strong with day 4 going to 2 theaters I've never been to before including Radio City to see the Christmas Spectacular featuring the Rockettes grab some dinner at the Meatball Shop before heading to the James Earl Jones Theater to go see Ohio State Murders this is my second to last Broadway house we only have one more left and no better way to finish this trip off than with Audra McDonald
classificationReason: 4-day NYC trip vlog covering 7+ shows (Down State, Ain't No Mo, Evanston Salt Costs Climbing, A Christmas Carol, The Far Country, Christmas Spectacular, Ohio State Murders) with no single focus. Qualifies as a roundup; none of these shows are on the provided list.
